react.message: Platform-agnostic zone: don't import react directly. Use RN-compatible libs (zustand, @tanstack/react-form, @tanstack/react-query) instead.

react-dom.message: DOM is web-only. Move to apps/web/src/components/ or features/*/ui/.

react-dom/client.message: DOM is web-only. Move to apps/web/src/components/ or features/*/ui/.

react-dom/server.message: DOM is web-only. Move to apps/web/src/components/ or features/*/ui/.

lucide-react.message: Icons are web-only. Move to apps/web/.

maplibre-gl.message: MapLibre is a browser map renderer. Keep map UI in apps/web/.

sonner.message: sonner is web-only. Call toast from ui/ after logic/ resolves.

patterns.message: Routing is platform-specific. Pass route params/state into logic/ as plain args.
TanStack Start is a web framework. Server functions live outside packages/core/.
Base UI is web-only. Move to apps/web/.
react-icons is web-only. Icons belong in apps/web/.
Serwist runs in service workers — web-only.
components/ is web-only UI. Don't import it from platform-agnostic code.
Don't import another feature's ui/ — cross-feature reuse goes through logic/ or components/ui/. Sibling files in the same feature use relative paths.
